result.summary: The page is mostly coherent, but the most noticeable problem is a stuck loading spinner over the Tokumaru Ramen Bar image, making that popular item look unfinished or broken. A few horizontal lists are also cropped at the right edge, which is normal for carousels but can read as clipped content without clearer affordance.

issues.description: A circular loading spinner is centered on the Tokumaru Ramen Bar image in the 'Popular right now' section while the rest of the page appears loaded, making the card look stuck or broken.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the image/video finishes loading or fails gracefully; replace the spinner with the final media, a retry state, or a static thumbnail if loading times out.

issues.description: The right-most items in the category chips and 'Fastest near you' carousel are visibly cut off at the screen edge, including the partially visible 'Healthy' chip and truncated 'Trattoria Piccol...' card.
issues.suggestion: Add clearer horizontal-scroll affordance such as edge fade, arrows, or slightly more inset/peek spacing so intentional cropping does not look accidental.

issues.description: Favorite heart icons and the notification bell appear as icon-only controls with no visible labels.
issues.suggestion: Provide accessible labels such as 'Save Tokumaru Ramen Bar' and 'Notifications' so screen readers and touch users can understand the controls.
